summary: Tested phone-first authentication flows in LoginSheet.jsx. All UI components and flows work correctly. Admin email login fails with 'Invalid login credentials' - this is a Supabase auth data issue, not a frontend bug.

critical.issue: Admin login (contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7) returns 'Invalid login credentials'. The admin account may not exist in Supabase or password is incorrect.

action_items: CRITICAL: Verify admin account (contact@actoos.com) exists in Supabase Auth with correct password (Salifkane&&7)
If admin account doesn't exist, create it in Supabase dashboard or via seed script
critical_code_review_comments: LoginSheet.jsx is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
AuthContext.jsx correctly implements phone-to-email workaround for Supabase (using fake email format: +223XXXXXXXX@actoos.phone)
Device fingerprinting is implemented correctly and persists across sessions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone authentication UI is fully functional. Admin email login fails due to Supabase auth data issue - admin account may need to be created/verified in Supabase.

test_1_phone_login_form.details: Phone login form displays correctly with +223 prefix, phone input (data-testid='login-phone-input'), password input, and all required links

test_2_phone_formatting.details: Phone number formats correctly as user types: '70000000' -> '70 00 00 00'

test_3_signup_transition.details: Clicking 'Créer un compte' transitions to signup form with Name, Phone (+223), and Password fields

test_4_signup_form.details: Signup form has all required fields: name input (data-testid='signup-name-input'), phone input (data-testid='signup-phone-input'), password input (data-testid='signup-password-input'), submit button (data-testid='signup-submit-btn')

test_5_email_login_option.details: 'Se connecter avec email' link visible and transitions to email login form

test_6_email_login_form.details: Email login form displays with email input (data-testid='login-email-input'), password input, submit button (data-testid='login-email-submit-btn'), and 'Retour à la connexion par téléphone' link

test_7_forgot_password_flow.details: 'Mot de passe oublié ?' link visible, transitions to forgot password form with phone input and 'Envoyer le code' button. Error handling works (shows 'Aucun compte associé à ce numéro' for non-existent phone)

test_8_admin_email_login.details: Admin login with contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7 returns 'Invalid login credentials'. This is a Supabase auth data issue, not a frontend bug.

test_9_device_id.details: Device ID generated and stored in localStorage as 'actoos_device_id'. Format: ACT[hash][timestamp] (e.g., ACTA25B15BK51K). Persists across page reloads.

mocked_apis.Twilio SMS OTP: MOCKED - OTP code displayed in UI for testing (devCode field)

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Admin email login fails with 'Invalid login credentials'
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The admin account (contact@actoos.com) either doesn't exist in Supabase Auth or has a different password than 'Salifkane&&7'
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Verify/create admin account in Supabase Auth dashboard with correct credentials
